title: Big Tech Buybacks Stall as AI Spending Devours Cash
en: Five of America's largest technology groups have all but stopped repurchasing their own shares as artificial intelligence capital spending swallows their cash. Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta and Oracle returned just 9.3% of operating cash flow to shareholders through dividends and buybacks in the first three quarters of this year, the lowest share in at least fifteen years and down sharply from 27.4% a year earlier. The retreat removes a pillar that long supported rich technology valuations, leaving earnings-per-share growth to stand on its own. Rating agencies are taking note: S&P Global cut its outlook on Meta to negative, pointing to uncertainty around capital spending and free operating cash flow.
zh: 随着人工智能资本开支吞噬现金，美国五家最大科技集团已基本停止回购自家股票。今年前三季度，微软、Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta和甲骨文以股息和回购形式返还给股东的资金仅占其经营现金流的9.3%，为至少15年来最低水平，远低于去年同期的27.4%。这一退潮抽走了长期支撑科技股高估值的支柱，使每股收益增长不得不独自站住脚。评级机构已开始关注：标普全球将Meta的评级展望下调至负面，理由是其资本开支和自由经营现金流面临较大不确定性。

title: Hyperscalers Pledge Over Three Trillion Dollars for AI Infrastructure
en: Alphabet, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon and Oracle have pledged more than three trillion dollars for artificial intelligence infrastructure over coming years, according to their filings. Alphabet disclosed contractual commitments above one trillion dollars, nearly eight times the level a year earlier, spanning equipment, energy and leases. Meta's future pledges exceed eight hundred billion dollars, with almost half tied to data-centre leases that have not yet begun and are payable over terms of up to thirty years. Across the five companies, lease-payment commitments total roughly 1.3 trillion dollars and other purchase commitments about 1.9 trillion dollars. Oracle became the first large technology group pushed into negative free cash flow by data-centre spending.
zh: 根据各家公司的监管披露文件，Alphabet、Meta、微软、亚马逊和甲骨文承诺未来数年为人工智能基础设施投入超过3万亿美元。Alphabet披露的合同承诺总额超过1万亿美元，接近一年前的八倍，涵盖技术设备、能源和租赁。Meta的未来支出承诺超过8000亿美元，其中近一半对应尚未生效、最长分30年支付的数据中心租约。五家公司未来的租赁付款承诺合计约1.3万亿美元，其他采购承诺约1.9万亿美元。甲骨文成为首家因数据中心投入而被推入自由现金流为负的大型科技公司。
vocab: n. 承诺付款；合同义务
adj. 应付的；到期需支付的

title: Fed Holds Rates but Hawks Dissent, Lifting December Odds
src: 财经早餐 · 美联储观察
en: The Federal Reserve held its policy rate at 3.75% to 4.00% at its October meeting, yet two officials dissented in favour of a quarter-point increase, and markets quickly priced in further tightening. Dallas Fed president Lorie Logan said she still saw a need for at least two more increases totalling fifty basis points, while St. Louis Fed president Alberto Musalem argued that inflation remained high and broad enough to require prompt additional action. Futures pricing put the odds of a quarter-point rise in December at about 72%. For investors the signal mattered less for the decision itself than for how far the likely end point has now moved beyond earlier expectations.
zh: 美联储在10月议息会议上将政策利率维持在3.75%至4.00%区间，但有两位官员投反对票、主张加息25个基点，市场随即进一步计入收紧预期。达拉斯联储主席洛根表示，她仍认为至少需要再加息两次、累计50个基点；圣路易斯联储行长穆萨莱姆则主张，通胀高企且波及面广，有必要尽快采取进一步行动。期货市场定价显示，12月加息25个基点的概率约为72%。对投资者而言，关键信号不在于本次决定本身，而在于利率终点已比先前预期推后了多少。
vocab: n. 终点（此处指利率终点）

title: Anthropic Files for IPO as Blackstone Flags Junk Rating Risk
en: Anthropic has filed its registration statement for a Nasdaq listing, giving investors a first detailed look at the OpenAI rival's finances. The documents show revenue of 16.3 billion dollars in the first half of 2026, cash on hand of 112 billion dollars and an expected annualised recurring revenue run rate of about 100 billion dollars for the full year. Class F shares leave its seven founders holding 50.1% of voting power. Blackstone, however, has told investors in a 63-billion-dollar chip financing deal that the company is unlikely to win an investment-grade rating immediately after listing and may instead sit in the higher rungs of the junk tier.
zh: Anthropic已向纳斯达克提交上市注册声明，投资者首次得以详细审视这家OpenAI竞争对手的财务状况。文件显示，公司2026年上半年营收163亿美元，账面现金1120亿美元，预计全年年度经常性收入运行率约为1000亿美元。通过发行F类股票，七位创始人持有50.1%的投票权。不过黑石在630亿美元芯片融资交易中告知投资者，该公司上市后短期内难以获得投资级评级，可能落入垃圾级中相对较高的一档。
vocab: n. 运行率（按当期推算的年化水平）

title: Apple Brings Alibaba's Qwen to Apple Intelligence in China
en: Apple said Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China through a partnership with Alibaba, the first time a Chinese large language model has been embedded natively in the iPhone maker's system features. Qwen will power capabilities inside Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence, letting users call directly on its text and image understanding as well as content generation. Apple will begin testing the features in a developer beta from November 4, with a release for Chinese users expected in December alongside iOS 27.3. The company said requests and generated responses will not be used by Alibaba to train its models, and that users may sign in with Apple or a Qwen account.
zh: 苹果宣布与阿里巴巴合作，Apple智能终于将在中国上线，这是中国大模型首次原生嵌入这家iPhone制造商的系统级功能。千问将为Siri、写作工具和视觉智能中的能力提供支持，用户可直接调用其文本与图像理解以及内容生成能力。苹果将于11月4日起在开发者测试版中开放这些功能，并预计随iOS 27.3于12月正式面向中国用户推出。苹果表示，用户请求和生成的回复都不会被阿里巴巴用于训练其模型，用户可通过Apple账户或千问账户登录。
vocab: adv. 原生地；在原生层面

title: Oil Rises a Fourth Month as Iran Risk Keeps Premium Intact
en: Oil climbed for a fourth consecutive month as tensions with Iran kept a risk premium embedded in prices. December Brent settled up 2.4% at 117.64 dollars a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate rose 2.1% to 104.12 dollars. Iran's Revolutionary Guards said a fourth tanker struck a mine and caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, and United States commercial crude inventories unexpectedly fell by 1.9 million barrels to 410.6 million. Qatari mediators held more than twelve hours of talks in Tehran, seeking reciprocal steps that could bring Washington and Tehran back to direct negotiations over the nuclear programme. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said no decision on military action had been taken.
zh: 受伊朗紧张局势推高价格中的风险溢价影响，油价连续第四个月上涨。12月交割的布伦特原油期货结算价上涨2.4%，至每桶117.64美元；西得克萨斯中质原油上涨2.1%，至104.12美元。伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队称，第四艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷起火；美国商业原油库存意外下降190万桶，至4.106亿桶。卡塔尔调解人员在德黑兰举行了超过12小时的会谈，寻求一系列对等措施，推动华盛顿与德黑兰重返就伊朗核项目的直接谈判。美国国务卿鲁比奥表示，尚未就军事行动作出决定。
